svg.aria-label: The journey of quantum-cortex as the page tells it: an idea from 2019, taken up again in 2021, carried through Quantum Meridian and a thermodynamics program, a register opened in August 2026, the eight weeks to the first edition, the landing edition tagged on the first of October and announced that night, archived the next day with the next edition's first measurement, the five weeks after the landing, and the page's note before the second edition, added in November
svg.title: A long haul: the journey from an idea to the weeks before the second edition, at the dates the page gives
svg.text: A long haul: seven years of an idea, then a register that refuses to answer faster than the evidence allows
the question: can a language model be given a memory that survives the end of a session, in a way that can be specified, measured and improved, at a scale one person can afford?
quantum-cortex, original figure for the journey page. The dates are the page's; the numbers of the record are not drawn here, the record holds them.
The idea is older than the record; it waited seven years partly for want of hands

g.text: 2019: the idea
exploring conversational assistants,
and a project of the author's own
2021: taken up again
the author takes the
idea up again
Quantum Meridian
the proxy and the agent around third party models; the decision to
gather what he had learned of language models into one attempt
A thermodynamics program first, on purpose
to understand inference and the transposition of laws;
it corrected this program and gave its gate one of its rules

svg.text: The register: declare, run, retain the files, read them cold, grave the row, let readers attack the graving

g.text: the register's first entry;
its rule from the first day:
thresholds frozen before any result;
every run's readings written down before
it ran; a log kept as a file before any
number in it is read; a failure a result,
attributed; the whole record public
the eight weeks to the first edition
the record accumulated measured rows, training
runs, dated revisions of the register, decisions
a claim withdrawn (a run whose log was never
retained), a router retrograded, a construction
error caught by re reading the code; most of the
model measurements INVALID, and said so
this page written; the landing
edition tagged and announced
the same night, as an edition
under review
the next day, 2026-10-02
archived under a citable identifier, the archive
checked against the tag's tree to the byte;
the next edition's first measurement,
declared the night before any number:
the organ withdraws the address of what
it evicts; its default changed, hence a
minor version, not a point release
the five weeks after the landing
what the landing had left open, in the
roadmap's order, under the same rule
a revision's history at one address; the index
geometry adopted after a bucket probe and an
external model arm; the near duplicates had to
produce their failure before any rule, then the
write gate and the read side took their rules; the
sealed test; the lifecycle at scale; a benchmark module

svg.text: The test the project had promised itself
families of formulations the system had never seen, sealed before any number, read once:
the system failed it on every cell, and the organ's own mark alone did what the model was
supposed to do; published in the same table as the rest, with the sentence declared for it
before it was known. A record that shows only what worked cannot be trusted about what worked.
one researcher with a language model as a working partner: the partner writes most of the code
and reads every log; the researcher sets the discipline, decides what enters and what waits, and
refuses a good part of what is proposed; neither is allowed to grave a number the other has not
read cold from a file; two committees read the last graving and the module before they were committed
next, declared before it is measured like everything here: the question of size, in the European high performance computing environment

g.text: before the record
the register and its editions
a failure published as a result
the pace and the partner
